messages:
noah-newhire: Hi team — quick q from onboarding. I changed my address in Workday to WA on 2025-01-10 but my first paycheck withheld OR. Also I had a dental cleaning on 2025-01-09 (day before start) and paid $85. If benefits get backdated can that be reimbursed?

cara-peopleops: Welcome @noah-newhire! For state withholding: if address change was after payroll cutoff we need a delta payroll request. DM your employee ID and upload proof of WA address. For dental: carriers sometimes allow retro to event date; if approved you file the claim, otherwise we can do a one-off reimbursement with receipt + carrier denial.

payroll-bot: Note: delta payroll requests take 1-2 pay cycles. Include proof of residency and date. See /payroll/delta-guide.

ben-hr: @cara I'll check payroll cutoff times. @noah-newhire please DM emp ID. If we process reimbursement via payroll it may be taxable; we'll confirm.

noah-newhire: DMed emp ID and uploaded receipt and WA lease. Thanks all!

cara-peopleops: Got it — opening ticket BEN-3456 to benefits and PR-998 to payroll. Will follow up when carriers respond or payroll confirms.

noah-newhire: Appreciate it :thumbsup:
